Current plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md. Owner approved proceeding with mandatory full event-graph delivery on 2026-11-16. DL1-DL6 are its first usable foundation in the common bundle; they do not replace the graph. Internal/external is a named policy-derived analysis of the reusable account, never a primitive kind or a fidelity judgment.
Engineering closure: all six DL implementation acceptance artifacts are landed, including the recurring-scene DL6 scorer/comparison condition, with explicit policy and evidence boundaries. Each child has one engineering acceptance artifact. Scientific qualification is separate: proposed DL1/DL3/DL4/DL6 fresh criteria transfer unchanged to the joint evaluation and never block implementation consumers. Failed criteria withhold corresponding scientific claims. DL5 may conclude unsupported/inconclusive.
Reuse existing identity/evidence-binding and claim-assessment components after exact-code qualification; retain alternative methods only for named comparisons. Claim children, not this container.
